newsitem.title: SPAIN: ATHLETICS-CUBA BROTHERS DOMINATE MADRID MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CUBA BROTHERS DOMINATE MADRID MARATHON.

text.p: Brothers Alberto and Alexis Cuba scored a memorable family one-two after shaking off the pack to dominate the Madrid marathon on Sunday.
Alberto came home nearly a minute ahead of Alexis, in just over two hours 16 minutes -- the best time for five years in the event. The women's race was won by their Cuban compatriot Sergia Martinez.
The Cuba brothers had changed pace throughout the early stages of the race to disrupt the rhythm of the Spanish runners, who were led by Rodrigo Gavela.
But Gavela, who has recently returned to top competition after two years of injury, faded at the half-way stage and had to be content with third, nearly three minutes back.
With the race reduced to a family battle, Alberto, the 1991 Pan-American champion, was able to pull away on the hilly section in the approach to the finish in Madrid's Retiro park.
